Then travel within CA by flight or rental car. Provide approximate budget allocation: flights ~ $800 roundtrip, intercity flights ~ $150 each, accommodation ~ $150/night, meals ~ $50/day, attractions ~ $30/day. Total roughly within $5800.

Day 2: March 8, LA city. Breakfast, attractions: Griffith Observatory, Hollywood Walk of Fame, Santa Monica Pier. Lunch, dinner, accommodation same.

Day 3: March 9, LA to San Diego (by rental car or flight). Transportation: Flight or drive. Provide. Breakfast in LA, travel, lunch in San Diego, attractions: Balboa Park, Gaslamp Quarter. Dinner, accommodation.

Day 4: March 10, San Diego. Attractions: San Diego Zoo, La Jolla Cove. Meals.

Day 5: March 11, San Diego to San Francisco (flight). Breakfast, travel, lunch, attractions: Fisherman's Wharf maybe arrival evening. Accommodation.

Day 6: March 12, San Francisco. Attractions: Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, Chinatown. Meals.

Day 7: March 13, depart from San Francisco to Kona (flight). Breakfast, travel, lunch on plane, arrival.
